protocol: parlay-profiles-v2: profiles fixed in engine/parlay_profiles.py before any backtest number; bands steady 4.5-6.5, risker 9.5-14, risk lover 50-100 (v1's 8-14 and 40-120 moved to the asked targets after v1 was seen - the labels, not the outcomes, drove it); each card priced from one snapshot; one ticket per card per profile, flat 1 unit; DEV 2016-11-01..2023-10-31, WINDOW 2023-11-01..end of walk-forward cache; mixed ships at a band only if its ROI beats the named profile's in both
caveats: PROTOCOL v2 - the bands moved after v1 was seen. v1 searched risker in 8-14 and the risk lover in 40-120; the search takes the likeliest combination in a band, so v1's tickets sat at the floor (window multipliers: risker median 8.32x (8x to 9.92x, 79 tickets); risk_lover median 41.62x (40.02x to 71.16x, 44 tickets)) - below the '~10x' and '50-100x' they were labelled. v2 moved the bands to the payouts the bettor asked for (risker 9.5-14, the risk lover 50-100; steady unchanged at 4.5-6.5) AFTER v1 was seen: the labels, not the outcomes, drove it - the bands were set from the request, not from any result - and every profile rule, the periods and the ship rule are unchanged. v1's results, ship decision (steady -> steady, risker -> risker, risk_lover -> mixed) and caveats are kept under "v1" for the record. v1 also let a ticket mix closing and opening prices (170 window tickets); v2 prices each card from one snapshot. v2 is a second look at the same cards, so its record is not independent of v1's.

A band is a range, not a payout: a ticket pays its multiplier only if every leg wins, and the likeliest combination in a band sits near its floor. What v2's window tickets carried: steady median 4.58x (4.5x to 5.53x, 56 tickets); mixed_else@steady median 4.59x (4.5x to 6.15x, 90 tickets); risker median 9.78x (9.52x to 11.66x, 75 tickets); risk_lover median 51.87x (50.07x to 71.16x, 36 tickets). Every rule and period is under "multipliers" (median, min, max).

The price snapshots differ. Window fights priced from the CLOSING line by year: 2023 35, 2024 346, 2025 0, 2026 201; from the OPENING line: 2023 7, 2024 36, 2025 217, 2026 0; unpriced 511; priced only in the snapshot their card did not use 83 (no leg). odds.csv has no 2025 prices, so 2025 is opening-only: an opening line is quoted days before the close, without fight-week news. Each card is priced from one snapshot - the one that prices more of its fights, ties to the close - because a ticket mixing the two could never have been bought; 0 window tickets mix them, so by_snapshot splits every window ticket.

Best-of-books prices overstate a multiplier. odds_cache.py keeps the best price per side across books, which no single book offered and which can even sum below 100% (devig rejects those). The live card is priced that way; of the window's close-priced fights, 0 came from odds_cache.json (its entries start 2026-09-27), so the record is on the price files' closing lines, while the live card's multipliers can run higher than any one book would pay for the same legs.

Method props stop on 2024-12-07, so risk_lover_method has no 2025 or 2026 tickets (window years with a method ticket: 2024). Its window record is 2023-11 to 2024 only; a prop leg's chance is the win chance times the six-way method market's share for that route, because the model has no route view here.

The 50-100x band lands rarely - wins of tickets: risk_lover dev 1 of 97 (ROI -0.48, interval -1.00 to +0.55; one hit more or fewer moves it 0.55); risk_lover window 0 of 36 (ROI -1.00, interval -1.00 to -1.00; one hit more or fewer moves it 1.48); mixed@risk_lover dev 3 of 78 (ROI +1.06, interval -1.00 to +3.77; one hit more or fewer moves it 0.67); mixed@risk_lover window 0 of 26 (ROI -1.00, interval -1.00 to -1.00; one hit more or fewer moves it 2.05); mixed_else@risk_lover dev 4 of 166 (ROI +0.27, interval -0.70 to +1.59; one hit more or fewer moves it 0.32); mixed_else@risk_lover window 0 of 60 (ROI -1.00, interval -1.00 to -1.00; one hit more or fewer moves it 0.89); risk_lover_method dev 6 of 130 (ROI +1.51, interval -0.18 to +3.63; one hit more or fewer moves it 0.48); risk_lover_method window 0 of 21 (ROI -1.00, interval -1.00 to -1.00; one hit more or fewer moves it 3.00). The ship decision at this band rests on a handful of hits. Read these as 'no evidence either way', not as a measured edge or loss.

Closing prices include fight-week news (weigh-ins, late replacements, injuries); a bettor who bets earlier gets a different price, and the blend weight (market_blend.MARKET_WEIGHT = 0.75) was fitted on closing lines and is applied unchanged to opening lines.

The walk-forward cache ends 2026-08-08; 12 cards after it (to 2026-10-31) have no point-in-time model probability and are not scored. They need the runner to refit model_compare_baseline_symmetric.csv - a probability from a model fitted after the fight would be a leak.

Draws and no contests (97 fights 2016-2026) are not in the walk-forward set, so they never become legs: a live ticket would sometimes carry a void leg (paid at 1.0) that this record never meets. The void rule is tested, not exercised.

678 of 5222 fights since 2016 have no usable price and 157 more a price only in the snapshot their card did not use; neither gives a leg. 151 closing-line rows are one fighter under two names (a married name, a family-name-first order) that only an entry in data/fighter_aliases.json can join.

The walk-forward models are up to a year staler than production (a December card is predicted by models fitted through the previous December), which understates a fresh model - the same for every profile and for the control.

Every ticket shares its card with the other profiles' tickets, so the profiles' records are not independent and a difference between two ROIs is not a measured difference unless it survives both periods. The bootstrap resamples tickets (one a card), not fighters.

The market is hard to beat in MMA. A combined probability is the model's blended belief; market_only sits beside every band as the control, and a profile that does not beat it has shown nothing the market did not already price. No profile here is presented as an edge.
